title: @better-auth/stripe 1.2.0-beta.18 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains an authorization bypass…
description: @better-auth/stripe versions 1.2.0-beta.18 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contain an authorization bypass vulnerability. This flaw allows users to replace their Stripe customer ID with another customer's ID via sign-up or update-user requests. Exploitation enables attackers who know another customer's Stripe ID to access that customer's billing portal, view invoices and billing details, change payment methods, and modify or cancel subscriptions.
